title: Wirelang Layer 3 — Capability Token (Biscuit v3 Wrapper)
description: JSON envelope around a Biscuit v3 token (eclipse-biscuit/biscuit SPECIFICATIONS.md, sections 'Format', 'Blocks', 'Signature (one block)', 'Signature (appending)', 'Signature (sealing)', 'Ed25519'). The on-the-wire token is the Biscuit binary; this schema describes the JSON-side projection that travels inside Wirelang Layer-1 frames or that is stored in registries. Authority block carries Wakir-specific intent fields (issuer, audience_pattern, caveats, validity window, nonce). Append blocks attenuate. Optional proof_block seals the token.

version.description: Token format version. Pinned to biscuit-v3 family (Biscuit SPECIFICATIONS.md 'Format' section: integer encodings 3..6 for v3.0..v3.3). Wakir Phase 1a defaults to v3.3 / Ed25519.

biscuit_format_version.description: Concrete Biscuit integer format version (3=v3.0, 4=v3.1, 5=v3.2, 6=v3.3). Optional; absence means v3.3 default.

aip_document_ref.description: URI of the AIP document (draft-prakash-aip-00 section 2.3) that anchors the issuer's root public key. The pubkey used to verify authority_block.signature MUST appear in that document's public_keys array (or biscuit_root_pubkey Wakir extension).

authority_block.description: Biscuit block 0 (root). Wakir projection of Datalog facts/checks into structured JSON for registry storage and review. The binary Biscuit token remains canonical.

issuer_did.description: Issuer identifier. Accepts AIP identifiers (aip:web:<domain>/<path> | aip:key:ed25519:<multibase>) per draft-prakash-aip-00 section 2.2, plus did:web for cross-compat with Wirelang Layer-1 source field.

audience_pattern.description: Audience pattern this token is intended for. Glob-like role/agent expression evaluated by the verifier (e.g., role=treasury-agent or aip:web:wakir.dev:cfo-agent).

caveats.description: Datalog caveat strings (Biscuit checks/rules). Each entry is a single Datalog statement as defined in eclipse-biscuit/biscuit SPECIFICATIONS.md ('Datalog' section).

not_after.description: Validity window end (RFC 3339). MUST be strictly greater than not_before (verifier-enforced; not expressible in pure JSON Schema).

nonce.description: Replay-protection nonce, lowercase hex, at least 16 bytes (32 hex chars).

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the canonical authority-block payload, lowercase hex, 64 bytes (128 hex chars). Algorithm per RFC 8032 / Biscuit SPECIFICATIONS.md 'Ed25519' section.

next_pubkey.description: Public key (pk_1) that signs the next block. Ed25519 compressed Edwards-Y, 32 bytes (64 hex chars). Per Biscuit 'Signature (one block)'.

append_blocks.description: Attenuation blocks (Biscuit SPECIFICATIONS.md 'Signature (appending)'). Each block adds caveats and is signed with the previous block's next_pubkey's secret. Empty array allowed (token never attenuated).

caveats.description: Additional Datalog caveats (only restrict, never expand).

next_pubkey.description: Public key for the next block. Ed25519 compressed, 32 bytes.

external_signature.description: Optional third-party block signature (Biscuit v1 'Signature version' for third-party blocks).

proof_block.description: Optional sealing block (Biscuit SPECIFICATIONS.md 'Signature (sealing)'). When present the token is sealed and MUST NOT be further attenuated; final_signature replaces the attenuable next_secret/next_pubkey continuation.

final_signature.description: Ed25519 final signature, lowercase hex, 64 bytes. Covers (last block data || algorithm || public key || previous signature).

sealed_at.description: Wall-clock time at which sealing was performed (informational; not part of Biscuit core spec).
